title: Docs and skills: the orchestrator now lives at the repo root
brief:
Markdown only. The folder orchestrator/ was moved to the repo root: src/, config/, test/, tasks/, vault/, package.json now sit at the top and every command runs from the repo root. Edit only the four files listed.
1. AGENTS.md: line 3 says the code lives in `orchestrator/`: say it lives at the repo root. The heading `## Commands (run inside orchestrator/)` becomes `## Commands (run from the repo root)`.
2. In the three SKILL.md files replace every `orchestrator/tasks/`, `orchestrator/vault/` with `tasks/`, `vault/`; replace "Commands run in `orchestrator/`", "All commands run inside `orchestrator/`", "Then in `orchestrator/`:" and "The orchestrator in `orchestrator/`" with wording that says the repo root; in the orchestrator skill's description change "(orchestrator/)" to "(repo root)".
Do not change anything else: keep commands, tables and the frontmatter name lines exactly as they are.

title: Add `npm run setup` for a fresh clone
brief:
TypeScript run directly by Node 24 (no build; imports end in .ts; only erasable syntax; no new packages). Repo root is the orchestrator. Read src/util.ts (ROOT, commandExists(name): boolean, shell, writeJson), src/config.ts (loadConfig, Config, ProviderConfig: providers keyed by name with kind, enabled, command) and test/pick.ts for the test style (node:assert/strict, prints `<name> PASS`).
1. Create scripts/setup.ts exporting:
 - `writeLocal(root: string): boolean`: if `<root>/config/local.json` does not exist, write `{ "_about": "This machine's overrides of config/orchestrator.json (same shape, merged on top, git-ignored)." }` with writeJson and return true; if it exists, never touch it and return false.
 - `toolReport(providers: Record<string, { kind: string; enabled?: boolean; command?: string }>): string[]`: one line per provider with kind "cli" and enabled true: `ok      <name> (<command>)` when commandExists(command), else `missing <name> (<command>): install it or set enabled false in config/local.json`.
 - When run directly (compare import.meta.url with pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href): print whether local.json was created, print toolReport(loadConfig().providers), and only with the flag `--openhands`: if `uv` exists run `uv venv --python 3.12 "$HOME/.orch/openhands-venv" && uv pip install --python "$HOME/.orch/openhands-venv" openhands-sdk openhands-tools` through shell() and print its tail, else print that uv is needed (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Exit 0 even when tools are missing.
2. Create test/setup.ts: in a temp dir with a config/ folder, writeLocal returns true then false and a second call keeps a file you changed in between; toolReport({ a: {kind:"cli",enabled:true,command:"node"}, b: {kind:"cli",enabled:true,command:"no-such-tool-xyz"}, c: {kind:"cli",enabled:false,command:"node"}, d: {kind:"api",enabled:true} }) gives exactly 2 lines, the first starting "ok", the second "missing". Print `setup PASS`.
3. package.json: add script "setup": "node scripts/setup.ts" and append ` && node test/setup.ts` to the "test" script.
Do not change any other file.
